description: I keep waiting to run into Troy Jackson somewhere in Maine, and it hasn’t happened. Susan Collins has been all over the state this summer: the Windsor Fair, the front gate at Bath Iron Works, the Acadian Festival in Madawaska, and a new affordable housing opening in Calais. She talks to local reporters and answers tough questions […]
